note: Issue 444, patrons.md section 6. A Doctrinaire patron, now and then, when the colony has sold the Crown the resource he disapproves of: his regard falls every such month whether or not he writes, and this is the letter that tells the PC why. Unskippable because a patron cares about no measure and a skippable letter from him would never clear his threshold; the cooldown is what makes it now and then. Placeholder prose.

body.text: I understand the colony has been selling {param:resource} to the Crown again.

I have made my views on {param:resource} plain to you before, and I shall not rehearse them. I will only say that every shipment of it is a shipment I am obliged to hear about, and that I do not enjoy hearing about it.
I do not ask you to stop. I merely tell you what it costs you with me.

options.text: and the colony must live on something
and I shall sell what I please
